Michigan's largest retro gaming celebration is back.

The Detroit Retro Gaming Show takes over Southfield Pavilion on Saturday, Nov 7. Run by Detroit gamers, for Michigan gamers.

🗓 Sat, Nov 7 · 10AM to 4PM (VIP access at 9AM)
📍 Southfield Pavilion, 26000 Evergreen Rd, Southfield
🎟 $15 cash at the door
🔗 detroitretrogamingshow.com
📲 @detroit.retro.gaming.show

Bring cash and bring a friend who still owns a CRT.

Motor City Comic Con is back in Novi.

One week out. Fall edition runs Fri Nov 13 to Sun Nov 15 at Vibe Credit Union Showplace. Weekend adult passes are $105, single days run $38 to $48, and the organizer's site has the full ticket list.

🗓 Nov 13 to 15
